# PRD -- Slice 8: Evidence Discovery Rail

Sprint: Phase 2 / Workstream Backend
Status: Proposed (2026-07-19)
Ticket handle: PAXOS-S8-DISCOVERY
Owner: Platform Engineering
Last updated: 2026-07-19

================================================================================
1. PROBLEM SUMMARY
================================================================================

ClearAuth generates appeal letters grounded in PA criteria retrieved from
`data/pa_requirements.json`, but it has no mechanism for retrieving external
clinical evidence -- published guidelines, PubMed literature, or payer LCD/NCD
policies -- that would substantiate the appeal beyond the internal criteria
pack. Reviewers currently source this evidence manually, outside the platform.

The roadmap (doc 10, unit O6) lists the Evidence Discovery Rail as "proposed
2026-07-17 -- demo rail shipped (EvidenceDiscoveryConsole); no backend." The
Qdrant vector store targeted by Sprint 5 (policy_ingest) is the natural peer
of this feature, and the dependency is shared: both require qdrant-client +
sentence-transformers (pre-install protocol gate, ADR-0007).

Concretely missing:

- No /api/discovery/* endpoint family exists.
- The retrieval node has no vector-search path; it resolves only against
  pa_requirements.json.
- There is no EvidenceQuery or EvidenceResult domain model.
- The EvidenceDiscoveryConsole in the demo is entirely fixture-driven with no
  backend.
- Claim-to-citation faithfulness scoring (eval_dimensions.claim_citation) is
  un-wired against retrieved evidence spans.

================================================================================
2. GOALS
================================================================================

1. Introduce an Evidence Discovery Rail consisting of a new
   /api/discovery/search endpoint and a DiscoveryEngine backed initially by a
   keyword/BM25 path over the existing data/pa_requirements.json corpus (zero
   new deps), with a Qdrant vector path as a drop-in extension guarded by
   ADR-0007 pre-install review.

2. Define canonical EvidenceQuery / EvidenceResult / DiscoveryResponse models
   in backend/models/schemas.py with TypeScript parity.

3. Add a retrieval node extension (run_discovery_retrieval) that populates
   PipelineState.evidence_refs -- a list of grounded evidence spans the
   synthesis node can cite.

4. Expose a document Q&A sub-route (POST /api/discovery/ask) that answers a
   natural-language question against a retrieved evidence set, driven by the
   LLM backend (streaming SSE, same pattern as the appeal route).

5. Wire the claim_citation eval dimension to check generated letter claims
   against evidence_refs rather than the fixed criteria pack alone.

6. Ensure the demo EvidenceDiscoveryConsole can be backed by the live endpoint
   via the capability manifest (src/capabilities.ts) without any fixture-path
   changes to simulated mode.

================================================================================
3. NON-GOALS
================================================================================

- Qdrant production deployment. The vector path is behind the ADR-0007
  pre-install gate; this slice ships the keyword path only, with the Qdrant
  path stubbed as a pluggable strategy.
- PubMed / external API integration. External literature retrieval is a future
  connector; this slice works only against the internal corpus.
- Full-text PDF ingestion. Policy PDFs under backend/golden/policies/ are
  already extracted to .md; this slice indexes the markdown, not raw PDFs.
- Changes to the core appeal generation pipeline topology. The discovery rail
  is a parallel call, not a replacement for the existing retrieval node.
- Langfuse trace emission for discovery. Observability is deferred (ADR-0007).

================================================================================
4. REQUIREMENTS
================================================================================

Functional
----------

E-1  POST /api/discovery/search accepts an EvidenceQuery (drug, diagnosis,
     plan_id, query_text, max_results) and returns a DiscoveryResponse
     (results list, resolution_path).

E-2  POST /api/discovery/ask accepts EvidenceAskRequest (query_text,
     evidence_ids) and streams an SSE response: step, chunk (answer tokens),
     done (with grounding refs), or error. No chunk events if
     LLM_BACKEND=mock.

E-3  The DiscoveryEngine is a Protocol with two implementations:
     KeywordDiscoveryEngine (BM25 over loaded corpus, no new deps) and
     VectorDiscoveryEngine (Qdrant -- guarded by ADR-0007 pre-install). The
     active engine is selected by an EVIDENCE_ENGINE env var; default is
     "keyword".

E-4  EvidenceResult carries: evidence_id (deterministic sha256[:12] of source
     + span), source (policy file path), span (verbatim text <= 500 chars),
     score (float 0-1), claim_type (guideline | policy | clinical |
     regulatory).

E-5  run_discovery_retrieval(state) -> PipelineState populates
     state.evidence_refs: list[EvidenceResult]; called by the graph after the
     existing retrieval node; always succeeds (empty list on corpus miss --
     never raises).

E-6  The synthesis prompt template (agents/prompts.py) is extended with an
     <evidence_refs> XML slot populated from state.evidence_refs; untrusted
     text isolation rule applies (XML-delimited, hard-4).

E-7  The claim_citation eval scorer (evals/appeal_evals.py) is updated to
     check letter claims against evidence_refs spans when present, falling back
     to the criteria pack when empty.

E-8  Both discovery routes are dual-auth (Bearer or cookie + CSRF) and
     tenant-scoped per ADR-0017.

E-9  EvidenceQuery.query_text is sanitized by the same sanitize_extracted_text()
     pipeline as denial-letter input before it reaches the engine or the LLM.

Non-functional
--------------

E-10 Keyword engine latency <= 200 ms at P95 for the full pa_requirements.json
     corpus.

E-11 evidence_id is deterministic: the same source + span always produces the
     same id; a retry never mints a new citation identity.

E-12 evidence_refs are metadata (hashes + spans) in the AuditRecord; full
     verbatim spans are not persisted in the audit trail.

E-13 POST /api/discovery/ask carries the same security-hold gate semantics: a
     request flagged at input sanitization never reaches the LLM.

================================================================================
5. WORKFLOW MODELING
================================================================================

Search flow
-----------

  POST /api/discovery/search
          |
          v
  auth_middleware -> TenancyScope
          |
          v
  sanitize_extracted_text(query_text)  <- injection check, same as ETL
          |
          v
  DiscoveryEngine.search(EvidenceQuery)
  |-- KeywordDiscoveryEngine (BM25 over corpus loaded at import)
  +-- VectorDiscoveryEngine  (Qdrant -- guarded by ADR-0007)
          |
          v
  DiscoveryResponse { results: EvidenceResult[], resolution_path: str }

Ask (Q&A) flow
--------------

  POST /api/discovery/ask  (SSE)
          |
          v
  auth_middleware -> TenancyScope
          |
          v
  sanitize_extracted_text(query_text)
  |-- security_hold? -> ErrorEvent (LLM never invoked)
  +-- pass
          |
          v
  resolve evidence_ids -> EvidenceResult[]
          |
          v
  build_ask_prompt(query_text, evidence_results)  <- XML-delimited slots
          |
          v
  LLMBackend.generate_stream(prompt)
          |
          v
  stream ChunkEvents -> collect -> DoneEvent { answer_ref, grounding_refs }

Pipeline integration
---------------------

  ingestion -> retrieval (pa_requirements.json) -> run_discovery_retrieval
                                                          |
                               PipelineState.evidence_refs populated
                                                          |
                                                   synthesis
                                    (prompt gains <evidence_refs> slot)

================================================================================
6. DATA MODEL CHANGES
================================================================================

New models (backend/models/schemas.py)
--------------------------------------

  class ClaimType(str, Enum):
      guideline  = "guideline"
      policy     = "policy"
      clinical   = "clinical"
      regulatory = "regulatory"

  class EvidenceResult(BaseModel):
      evidence_id : str        # sha256[:12] of f"{source}:{span}"
      source      : str        # policy file path / corpus key (<= 200 chars)
      span        : str        # verbatim excerpt <= 500 chars
      score       : float      # 0.0-1.0
      claim_type  : ClaimType

  class EvidenceQuery(BaseModel):
      model_config = ConfigDict(strict=True)
      drug        : str        # <= 200 chars
      diagnosis   : str        # <= 200 chars
      plan_id     : str        # <= 100 chars
      query_text  : str        # <= 1000 chars (sanitized at boundary)
      max_results : int = 5    # 1-20

  class DiscoveryResponse(BaseModel):
      results         : list[EvidenceResult]
      resolution_path : str    # "keyword" | "vector" | "empty"

  class EvidenceAskRequest(BaseModel):
      model_config = ConfigDict(strict=True)
      query_text   : str       # <= 1000 chars
      evidence_ids : list[str] # <= 20 ids from a prior search result

  class EvidenceAskDoneEvent(BaseModel):
      event          : Literal["done"] = "done"
      answer_ref     : str             # sha256[:12] of answer text
      grounding_refs : list[str]       # evidence_ids cited in the answer

PipelineState addition
-----------------------

  evidence_refs : list[EvidenceResult] = field(default_factory=list)

AuditRecord addition
---------------------

  evidence_ref_ids : list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
  # evidence_ids only, no full spans

Parity: ClaimType, EvidenceResult, EvidenceQuery, DiscoveryResponse,
EvidenceAskRequest mirror into src/types.ts. wire-types-freshness CI job
gates on no drift.

================================================================================
7. API CHANGES
================================================================================

New endpoints
-------------

POST /api/discovery/search
  Auth    : Dual scheme (Bearer or cookie + CSRF). Tenant-scoped.
  Body    : EvidenceQuery
  200     : DiscoveryResponse
  422     : Pydantic validation failure

POST /api/discovery/ask
  Auth    : Dual scheme. Tenant-scoped.
  Body    : EvidenceAskRequest
  200     : text/event-stream (step / chunk / done / error, same framing as
            appeal route)
  Note    : Requires LLM_BACKEND to be set; returns ErrorEvent if not (same
            pattern as /api/appeal/generate).

OpenAPI registration
---------------------

EvidenceAskDoneEvent registered via backend/openapi_ext.py (same pattern as
InitialPaDoneEvent) so the SSE event union is typed in the generated
api-types.d.ts.

================================================================================
8. LANGGRAPH INTEGRATION
================================================================================

New node: run_discovery_retrieval
Location: backend/agents/nodes/discovery_retrieval.py
----------------------------------

  run_discovery_retrieval(state: PipelineState) -> PipelineState
    engine = _get_engine()      # module-level singleton, loaded at import
    query = EvidenceQuery(
        drug       = state.request.drug,
        diagnosis  = state.request.diagnosis,
        plan_id    = state.request.plan_id,
        query_text = state.request.denial_text[:500],
        max_results = 5
    )
    results = engine.search(query)   # always succeeds -- empty list on miss
    state["evidence_refs"] = results.results
    return state

Graph topology change (agents/graph.py):

  retrieval -> discovery_retrieval -> synthesis

A StepEvent("discovery_retrieval") is emitted by the wrapper node before
delegation to the pure function. The node is inserted between retrieval and
synthesis; no conditional edges added; it always runs and always succeeds.

Prompt extension (agents/prompts.py)
--------------------------------------

The synthesis template gains an <evidence_refs> XML block:

  <evidence_refs>
  {evidence_refs_block}
  </evidence_refs>

evidence_refs_block is:
  "\n".join(f"[{r.evidence_id}] ({r.claim_type}): {r.span}" for r in evidence_refs)
  or "(no external evidence retrieved)" when the list is empty.

Untrusted text isolation rule (hard-4) applies: slot is XML-delimited, never
raw-interpolated.

================================================================================
9. NEW MODULE: backend/agents/engines/
================================================================================

  backend/agents/engines/
  |-- __init__.py
  |-- base.py           # DiscoveryEngine Protocol
  |-- keyword_engine.py # KeywordDiscoveryEngine (BM25, no new deps)
  +-- vector_engine.py  # VectorDiscoveryEngine (Qdrant stub -- raises
                        # NotImplementedError until ADR-0007 clearance)

DiscoveryEngine Protocol:

  class DiscoveryEngine(Protocol):
      def search(self, query: EvidenceQuery) -> DiscoveryResponse: ...

KeywordDiscoveryEngine: loads pa_requirements.json corpus + policy markdown
files at module import (same pattern as retrieval.py). BM25 scoring uses
collections.Counter token frequency -- zero new dependencies.

Env var:
  EVIDENCE_ENGINE=keyword   # default
  EVIDENCE_ENGINE=vector    # requires Qdrant + ADR-0007 sign-off

================================================================================
10. UI SURFACES
================================================================================

Backend slice only. The demo EvidenceDiscoveryConsole at
src/components/portfolio/EvidenceDiscoveryConsole.tsx currently runs on fixture
data. When the live endpoint exists, the capability manifest
(src/capabilities.ts, unit O6) transitions it from simulated -> live. The SPA
calls POST /api/discovery/search via src/lib/api.ts with streamDiscoveryAsk
added alongside the existing typed wrappers.

No fixture-path changes are required for simulated mode -- the manifest seam
preserves the offline demo behavior.

================================================================================
11. TEST CASES
================================================================================

Unit (backend/tests/unit/)
---------------------------

Module: test_keyword_engine.py
  - BM25 search returns ranked results
  - empty corpus returns empty list
  - max_results honored
  - query_text sanitization called before search
  - deterministic evidence_id for same source+span

Module: test_discovery_retrieval_node.py
  - Node populates evidence_refs
  - corpus miss returns empty list without raising
  - node is pure (no I/O inside the function after module load)

Module: test_evidence_models.py
  - EvidenceQuery strict-mode rejects coercion
  - evidence_id determinism
  - ClaimType enum parity

Module: test_ask_prompt.py
  - evidence_refs slot populated correctly
  - empty list produces placeholder text
  - XML slot is isolated (no raw interpolation)

Module: test_claim_citation_scorer.py
  - scorer finds citation when span appears in letter text
  - scorer returns 0.0 when no evidence_refs and no criteria match
  - fallback to criteria pack when evidence_refs empty

Contract
--------

test_schema_parity.py extended: ClaimType present in both schemas.py and
src/types.ts.
wire-types-freshness CI job: EvidenceQuery, DiscoveryResponse,
EvidenceAskRequest in generated types.

Integration (backend/tests/integration/)
-----------------------------------------

Module: test_discovery_endpoint.py
  - Bearer auth search returns 200 with results
  - cookie auth search works
  - query_text injection phrase triggers 200 with security_hold in response
    (no LLM reached)
  - max_results honored
  - empty corpus returns empty results gracefully

Module: test_discovery_ask_endpoint.py
  - ask SSE stream produces step/chunk/done sequence
  - security-hold input returns error event
  - no chunk events in mock mode returns done directly
  - unknown evidence_ids returns graceful empty grounding_refs

Module: test_pipeline_with_discovery.py
  - Full pipeline run includes discovery_retrieval step event
  - DoneEvent audit record contains evidence_ref_ids
  - evidence_refs slot appears in synthesis prompt

================================================================================
12. RISKS
================================================================================

Risk: BM25 quality insufficient for real evidence retrieval
  Likelihood: High | Impact: Medium
  Mitigation: Acceptable for this slice (keyword path is a scaffold); Qdrant
  vector path is the production target -- gated on ADR-0007.

Risk: evidence_refs slot inflates prompt token count past context window
  Likelihood: Medium | Impact: Medium
  Mitigation: max_results=5 default; ContextWindowError already handled by
  errors.py; span truncated at 500 chars.

Risk: Injection via query_text to the ask LLM
  Likelihood: Medium | Impact: High
  Mitigation: Same sanitize_extracted_text() + security-hold gate as
  denial-letter ETL; XML-delimited slot in prompt.

Risk: evidence_id collision for distinct spans
  Likelihood: Very Low | Impact: Low
  Mitigation: sha256[:12] over full "{source}:{span}" string; collision
  probability negligible at corpus scale.

Risk: ADR-0007 delay blocks Qdrant path
  Likelihood: Medium | Impact: Low
  Mitigation: Keyword engine is a complete fallback; Qdrant path ships only
  after clearance.
